text: Authorities in France suppressed the Marquis de Sade's Justine or the Misfortunes of Virtue in 1791. In March 1801 the stocks of The New Justine and Juliette were seized when Sade was arrested at his publisher's office, and on 19 May 1815 the Cour Royale de Paris ordered the book's destruction.
meta_description: Sade's Justine or the Misfortunes of Virtue was suppressed in France in 1791; its destruction was ordered by the Cour Royale de Paris on 19 May 1815.
changes: Result first; the 1801 and 1815 events joined in one sentence.
